releaseTitle: PostHog Observability And PWA Asset Repair
notes: Restores the app-owned PWA/header icon assets so manifest and icon source integrity checks can pass.
Adds environment-gated PostHog browser analytics with explicit page, identity, problem report, and runtime error events while keeping autocapture and session recording disabled by default.
Forwards saved crash/problem reports to PostHog from the API when server PostHog env vars are configured, without blocking the existing Firestore crash report workflow.
